title: dactylis maritima var. littoralis
intro: Dactylis maritima var. littoralis, commonly known as coastal cock's foot, is a subspecies of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing inflammation and oxidative stress in the body. The therapeutic actions of Dactylis maritima var. littoralis include its potential to modulate the immune system, improve digestive health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
